key_findings.text: Leverage is low: total {{FIG:total_leverage_reported}} and net {{FIG:net_leverage_reported}} on reported EBITDA for the twelve months to FY2025, with interest cover of {{FIG:interest_coverage_reported}}.
All debt is a single senior secured term loan maturing on December 31, 2029 with no revolver, which concentrates refinancing risk at one date. Total leverage is {{FIG:total_leverage_reported}}.
Quarterly dividends to the sole shareholder continue while their funding source and the owners behind the holding company are undisclosed. Total leverage is {{FIG:total_leverage_reported}}.
Customer concentration, covenant terms and an audit report are missing, so the credit view stays provisional. Total leverage is {{FIG:total_leverage_reported}}.

thesis.text: Northbridge Synthetic Group is a low-leverage, cash-generative industrial manufacturer whose credit strength rests on unaudited figures and a single maturity, so the view is a provisional stable thesis pending covenant terms and customer disclosure. Total leverage is {{FIG:total_leverage_reported}}.

weaknesses.label: Single maturity and no revolver
weaknesses.text: All debt is one senior secured term loan with no revolving facility, so liquidity rests on cash and operating cash flow and refinancing is concentrated at one date. Total leverage is {{FIG:total_leverage_reported}}.

weaknesses.label: Customer concentration unassessed

weaknesses.text: Customer concentration and the revenue split are not disclosed, so revenue durability cannot be confirmed.

weaknesses.label: Distributions and unaudited reporting
weaknesses.text: Dividends are paid to the sole shareholder every quarter, the funding source is not documented and the statements are unaudited, which weakens confidence in cash available for debt service. Total leverage is {{FIG:total_leverage_reported}}.
